common.transfer_text: Moving your consulting, internal audits or training to us is simple. We review your current system, certificates and plans, then pick up where your previous provider left off. Any transfer of certification between certification bodies is handled by the receiving certification body under accreditation rules.

footer.about_text: ICFC provides audit, consulting and training for ISO management systems, cybersecurity, data protection and sustainability standards in Singapore.

home.title: Audit, consulting and training you can trust
home.intro: Since 2014, ICFC has helped organisations in Singapore and across Asia Pacific achieve and keep ISO, cybersecurity, IT assurance, data protection and Singapore standards. Impartial audits, practical consulting, and training in class or online.
home.need_consultation: I need to prepare or implement
ways: Third-party audits delivered by our auditors on behalf of accredited certification bodies, plus second-party and internal audits.
Classroom and online through the ICFC Digital LMS.
home.edge_text: From 30 September 2026, business grant support moved to the EDGE Grant. Many standards we support are listed, with up to 50% support for SMEs and up to 70% for sustainability standards, subject to eligibility and Enterprise Singapore's approval. ICFC's consultancy is led by SS 680:2021 certified consultants, as EDGE requires for Standards activities. CSA separately funds first Cyber Trust and Cyber Essentials certifications until 6 February 2028.
home.edge_small: Grant decisions are made by Enterprise Singapore. Information checked 11 October 2026.
why: Consulting and auditing roles are kept apart, and every engagement starts with a conflict-of-interest check.
Our auditors handle integrated management systems, so several standards can be audited together, saving time and cost.
ICFC's consultancy is led by consultants certified to SS 680:2021, the standard Enterprise Singapore requires for consultancy support under EDGE Standards activities.
Classroom and online training on the ICFC Digital LMS keeps your team capable after the project ends.
